youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the prayers still on blank pages.

She: Jesus... I found my old prayer journal tonight. 📔
She: Two years of requests. So many pages still blank. I almost closed it and stopped hoping for good.
Jesus: A blank page isn't a refused prayer. Some promises carry dates you can't see yet.
She: But what if the answer never comes? Reading those pages just hurts.
Jesus: What I promise, I perform. Hope isn't pretending the blanks are filled. It's trusting the Author isn't done writing.
Jesus: Bring the journal back out. Not to count the blanks. To see how far you've already come.
What's one prayer you're still waiting to see filled?

“Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.”
Jeremiah 33:14 (KJV)

The Author isn't done writing.
